title: Pay for your boost
intro: Pick what you want, check the total, and pay with PayPal. Nothing is charged until you approve it there.

contact.label: Questions before you pay?
contact.note: Email or call and a person will answer — no chatbot, no form to fill in.

promises: Nothing is charged until you approve it inside PayPal.
Your card and bank details stay with PayPal — this site never sees them.
Every order gets a short email from a person within a working day.

offline.title: Checkout is not switched on yet
offline.body: The PayPal keys are not in place on this deployment, so nothing can be paid for right now. The prices below are still correct — email or call and we will sort it out by hand.

success.contactLabel: Something not right with this order?
success.title: Thank you — that is booked in
success.intro: PayPal has taken the payment and emailed you a receipt. Keep that email: it has the transaction id on it.
steps: You get a short confirmation from a person, usually within one working day.
Work on a placement or a service starts as soon as that email lands.
Anything unclear, reply to that email — it comes straight to us.
